title: Clean up LLM provider support matrix

context.summary: Centralize LLM role/provider support levels and enforce unsupported model choices through config and installer validation.
context.background: TASK-71 added release automation. Before real provider adapters expand, public users need accurate supported/experimental/future model-role gating.

in: Add an LLM role/provider support matrix to the config catalog.
Classify supported, experimental and future roles/providers based on current implementation.
Require experimental mode before enabling experimental/future roles or selecting non-supported providers.
Keep disabled roles valid without experimental mode.
Update installer validation and wizard behavior.
Update LLM/config/support docs and generated .env.example comments.
Add validation coverage for the support matrix and installer gating.
out: Changing runtime behavior for disabled roles.
Adding model downloads or local model runners.
Changing vector dimensions beyond the current pgvector schema.

acceptance_criteria: The config catalog defines role/provider support statuses.
Text embeddings are marked supported for OpenAI-compatible and Ollama providers.
Non-text roles are marked experimental or future according to current implementation.
Installer validation blocks experimental/future enabled roles and providers unless experimental mode is enabled.
Runtime config validation blocks experimental/future enabled roles and providers unless experimental mode is enabled.
Docs describe the support matrix and experimental flag behavior.

manual_checks: Confirm no new provider adapter implementation was added.

risks: Changing support statuses can break tests that intentionally enable experimental roles.
Docs and generated env comments must not overstate unsupported model operations.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
